required_ingest_rules: Use accession/PUID as identity; never match only on plant_name.
Preserve the original GRIN accession identifier and PUID when present.
Keep passport metadata separate from phenotype observations.
Convert wide GRIN/handbook-style trait columns to long phenotype rows without changing source values.
Reject unknown trait names into a quarantine report instead of silently renaming them.
Do not promote placeholder traits ending in _xxx or marked placeholder into canonical production measurements.
Derived fields such as days_2_* and kite_* must be tagged derived when recalculated rather than copied from source.
Preserve source URL, retrieval date, original column name, and source record identifier.

passport_field_policy.behavior: one normalized germplasm record per accession identity

phenotype_field_policy.behavior: one observation row per accession/plant + trait_name + context
